signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to your company's office.
signIn.companyHint: The short name your company signs in with. Your administrator can tell you.

code.title: Enter your code
code.subtitle: Signing in as {email}.
code.appHint: 6 digits. The app shows a new code every 30 seconds.
code.recoveryHint: One of the 10 codes you saved when you set up the app, like ABCDE-23456. Each one works once.

change.title: Choose a new password
change.subtitle: Your administrator asked you to choose a new password before you continue.

newPassword.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember. Do not use your name or email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We email you a link to choose a new password.

forgotSent.title: Check your email
forgotSent.body: If {email} has an account in this company, a link is on its way. It works for one hour. Nothing arrived? Look in the spam folder, or ask again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Every device signed in to your account will be signed out.

resetDone.title: Your password is set
resetDone.body: Sign in with your new password. If you use an authenticator app, it still asks for a code.

invite.title: Join {tenant}
invite.subtitle: You were invited as {email}. The invitation is open until {expires}.
invite.name: Your name
invite.nameHint: As your colleagues will see it.

inviteDone.title: Welcome
inviteDone.optional: Protect your account with an authenticator app: after the password, sign-in then asks for a code from your phone. You can also do it later from your profile.
inviteDone.required: Your role needs an authenticator app. Until you set it up, you can open only your profile.

resetInvalid.title: This reset link no longer works
resetInvalid.body: It was used, it expired, or a newer link replaced it. Ask for a new one.

inviteInvalid.title: This invitation no longer works
inviteInvalid.body: It was used, it expired or it was withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

missing.title: This address is not a complete link
missing.body: Open the link from your email again, or copy all of it into the browser.

field.emailFormat: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
field.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
field.recoveryFormat: A recovery code has 10 letters and digits, like ABCDE-23456.
field.passwordName: Do not use your name or email in the password.
field.repeatMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

problem.wrongCredentials: The company, email or password is not right. After several wrong tries the account is locked for a few minutes.
problem.wrongCode: The code is not right, or it was already used. Wait for the next code and try again. After several wrong tries the account is locked for a few minutes.
problem.suspended: This account cannot sign in at the moment. Ask an administrator of your company.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries from this device. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problem.unavailable: Nexus Factory is not answering. Try again in a moment.
problem.passwordRefused: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
problem.changeExpired: The time to choose a new password ran out. Sign in again.
problem.noCompany: Your account does not work in any company yet. Ask an administrator.
problem.invalid: Check what you entered and try again.
